$comment: COPY → ~/.paseo-pi-team/model-routing.local.json on EACH host. Never commit the local copy: it holds host-specific model choices. Values below are placeholders — run 'paseo provider ls' and 'paseo provider models pi-peer --json' on the host, then fill in real IDs. 'model' is the exact Pi model id in '<pi-provider>/<model-id>' form (it may itself contain slashes, e.g. 'openrouter/vendor/model-name' — Paseo splits at the FIRST slash only). 'thinking' ∈ off|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max and must be supported by the model (check model.thinkingOptions; for custom models in ~/.pi/agent/models.json, a thinkingLevelMap entry of null means that level is silently clamped by pi — treat it as unsupported).
